doc.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995

title: Recording albums with Joe Williams
summary: Heard recorded several albums with Joe Williams, one with Benny Golson and Thad Jones among others.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: Some of our folks have been talking about Joe Williams. I wondered if Joe ever had the opportunity to play with you on the same bandstand?
Yeah I recorded with him. I just worked with him not long ago. He has a great ... there is a nice album I recorded with Joe.

He had Benny Golson, Thad Jones, let’s see who else, I can’t really remember. Did he have Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis? I can’t remember all the guys that was on the date but it was great. Very nice. I’ve done several albums with him.
